summary.text: Karianne Lisonbee is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 14 in Davis County, serving her fourth term since January 2017. She sits on the House Education Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before her election to the Legislature, Lisonbee served on the Syracuse City Council.
She earned a degree in Family Studies from Brigham Young University.
Her official biography says she passed legislation making Utah's communities and schools safer by increasing accountability and transparency in the criminal justice system.
